sources: rmxlinux Json/SkillData/sk_wpn_sword_0023 (game 1.6), passiveEventActions: abilityEvent 50 (a heal by the wielder) with CheckHealTag −1517158118 (the combo-skill heal tag; no CheckTargetsEqual, so the wielder's heals of itself count too) → CreateBuff buff_wpn_sword_0023_intensityup (attribute 87 Arts Intensity + phy_spell_up) and buff_wpn_sword_0023_spelldmgup (attributes 51–54 Heat / Electric / Cryo / Nature DMG + spell_dmg_up) on the healed operator (targetSource 0), both for `duration` (20 s). Both are stackingType 11 with a priority key and maxStackCnt 1 ("Effects of the same name cannot stack"): the loader makes each a stack group from its game buff (batch 3 B2), so two wielders' copies don't add, and a new heal refreshes the 20 s. Values: SkillPatchTable sk_wpn_sword_0023 (level 9: phy_spell_up 14, spell_dmg_up 0.098). Max HP + hp_up (cardAttributeModifier), Strength and Treatment Efficiency are on the stat panel.

It acts for any wielder whose kit declares combo-kind heals (a trigger heal with healKind combo, or a hit's heals): Purrchena's giftbox and Yummy Dessert, Liino's combo. Not in any log or fixture yet. Batch-3 report docs/kit-batches/batch-3/chr_0038_purrche.md rows E1–E3.

triggers.note: "When the wielder's combo skill grants HP treatment, the operator receiving this HP treatment gains Arts Intensity +{phy_spell_up} and Arts DMG Dealt +{spell_dmg_up} for {duration}s": every combo-tagged heal by the wielder, to whomever it heals (the wielder included).
